main_issue: Whether and how the drinks Agent A bought can be stored in the shared fridge given Agent D's alcohol recovery; the group settles on hiding them in a box or bags at the back of the fridge.

A-B.evidence: B thanks A for the drinks (2) and then proposes a cooler box or bags in the fridge (16), which keeps the drinks cold as A insisted (15). A has not yet explicitly agreed.

A-C.evidence: C proposes buying drinks later (12) and keeping them in A's room (14), and A refuses both (13, 15). C then adopts the in-fridge cover idea (17) and asks A to do it (19), but A hasn't replied.

A-D.evidence: A says the drinks must stay in the fridge (15), and D accepts the bag arrangement (18). A never responds to D directly and has not yet agreed.

B-C.evidence: C: 'That sounds like a good idea' (17) to B's box/bag proposal (16); C then asks A to carry it out (19).

B-D.evidence: B proposes hiding the drinks in a box or bags (16), and D says 'Yeah, I think that would help' (18).

C-D.evidence: C seeks to accommodate D (12, 14, 17), and D agrees the box/bags would work (18). C follows up (19).
